messages:
sara.marketing: Heads-up — seeing ~25% of inbound EMEA leads stall during enrichment and never hit owner queues. Spike ~08:43 UTC. Any quick wins?
aj-bizops: Oof. Is this enrichment TTL or webhook timeout? Can you paste an example lead id?
sara.marketing: Example lead 632198. HubSpot enrichment logs show `response_timeout` coming back from org-enrich service. After timeout we mark contact as 'enrichment_failed' and it falls to unowned queue, but our RR only triggers on creation, so it never gets assigned. :confused:
miguel-sdr: So leads are created but assignment job isn't re-running on property updates. Can we change routing to also run on contact property change (hs_enriched) as a stopgap?
beth-sales: If we re-trigger RR on enrichment completion we risk double-assigning if assignment already happened on create. Need idempotency key check (e.g., last_assigned_job_id).
sara.marketing: Proposal: implement a 30s "deadband" gate — if enrichment completes within 30s of creation, allow enriched pipeline + run RR; else send to overflow/unowned. Implementation: small HubSpot workflow change + add `enriched_within_deadband=true` flag via enrichment webhook. Also add `enrichment_attempts` counter to contact to prevent loops.
aj-bizops: Sounds reasonable. Quick mitigation: toggle RR listeners to also act on `hs_enriched=true` property so recent leads get reprocessed. I'll prep a HubSpot workflow canary for EU only.
miguel-sdr: I'll watch SDR queue and add alert for >10 leads/hour without owner. Also agree on `enrichment_attempts` cap (3).
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled for 2025-03-23T09:15:00Z — patch id `hb-deadband-1`.
beth-sales: If canary looks good, roll to prod. Action owners: @aj-bizops update HubSpot workflows + webhook mapping, @sara.marketing update runbook & docs, @miguel-sdr monitor queues and alerts. Rollback criteria: >5% increase in unowned leads at 1h or any double-assigns.
sara.marketing: I'll add the runbook entry now and paste the HubSpot snippet for the workflow filter:```property: hs_createdate <= (now - 30s) OR property: enriched_within_deadband == true```Will post follow-up with lead IDs and logs after canary. Thanks everyone!
